title: WeatherNext adds about a day of accuracy to cyclone forecasts
friendlyTitle: AI cyclone forecasts may give people one more day to prepare
summary: Google DeepMind says WeatherNext predicts cyclone tracks, intensity and wind structure with a lead-time advantage of more than 24 hours over earlier leading systems. The Nature-published work has already supported operational forecasts, and the models are being open-sourced.
friendlySummary: Google’s WeatherNext model can predict where cyclones go and how strong they become about one day earlier than older leading systems.
whyItMatters: An extra day of useful warning can improve evacuation, logistics and emergency planning. Open weights also give weather agencies and researchers a path to test and adapt the system rather than relying only on a closed forecast feed.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Earlier warnings can help families, emergency teams and businesses prepare. Google is also sharing the models for researchers to test.
